features.maintenance.locks.atTheEndItMay: At the end it may take ACCESS EXCLUSIVE for a moment to give empty pages at the end of a table back, and lets go as soon as another session waits; TRUNCATE OFF skips that.
features.maintenance.locks.concurrentlyK: CONCURRENTLY keeps reads and writes going.
features.maintenance.locks.eachTableClus: Each table clustered before (and owned by this role) is written anew in its index's order, one at a time: every read and write of that table waits meanwhile (ACCESS EXCLUSIVE).
features.maintenance.locks.everyReadAndW: Every read and write of {who} waits until it is written anew: VACUUM FULL takes ACCESS EXCLUSIVE{turn} and writes the table and its indexes anew.
Every read and write of {who} waits until it ends: CLUSTER takes ACCESS EXCLUSIVE and writes the table anew in the order of {using}, then builds its indexes.
features.maintenance.locks.freezeFreezes: FREEZE freezes every row it can: it reads the whole table and writes more.
features.maintenance.locks.howLongDepend: How long depends on the size: {value}.
features.maintenance.locks.ifItFailsOrIs: If it fails or is cancelled, an invalid index whose name ends in _ccnew stays behind: drop it, or run REINDEX again.
features.maintenance.locks.itNeedsFreeDi: It needs free disk for the new copy, up to {value} more, until it ends.
features.maintenance.locks.readsAndWrite: Reads and writes of {who} go on: VACUUM takes SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE, so only ALTER TABLE, CREATE INDEX and another VACUUM or ANALYZE of it wait.
Reads and writes of {who} go on: ANALYZE takes SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE and reads a sample of the rows, not the whole table.

Reads and writes of {who} go on: REINDEX CONCURRENTLY takes SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE, builds each index anew beside the old one and waits for transactions that could still use it, so it takes longer and needs room for a second copy ({room}).
features.maintenance.locks.skipLockedATa: SKIP_LOCKED: a table another session holds a conflicting lock on is skipped, not waited for.
features.maintenance.locks.systemCatalog: System catalogs are skipped: they cannot be reindexed concurrently.
features.maintenance.locks.tablespaceThe: TABLESPACE: the indexes built anew go to {tablespace}.
features.maintenance.locks.thePluginSend: The plugin sends it alone, outside a transaction block: VACUUM, REINDEX CONCURRENTLY, REINDEX of a schema or a database and CLUSTER of a database or a partitioned table cannot run inside one.
features.maintenance.locks.theStatementT: The statement timeout in the settings ({timeoutSeconds} s) ends it if it runs longer.
features.maintenance.locks.truncateOffIt: TRUNCATE OFF: it never takes ACCESS EXCLUSIVE to give empty pages back.
features.maintenance.locks.whileItWaitsF: While it waits for its lock, sessions that come after it wait too.
features.maintenance.locks.writesToWaitU: Writes to {who} wait until it ends (SHARE), and the index is locked ACCESS EXCLUSIVE while it is built anew; planning a query on the table locks all its indexes, so nearly every read waits too.
features.maintenance.locks.writesToWaitW: Writes to {who} wait while its indexes are built anew (SHARE{turn}), and each index is locked ACCESS EXCLUSIVE meanwhile; planning a query on a table locks all its indexes, so nearly every read waits too.
